_README: Overnight Elicitation hook block. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json with the existing installer (union/append, backs up first): `uv run python scripts/apply_overnight_permissions.py --block claude_assets/elicitation-overnight.block.json --apply`. First install the script: `cp claude_assets/hooks/elicitation_evalopt_overnight.py ~/.claude/skills/eval-opt/hooks/`. Alternatively, declare the same `hooks` block in ~/.claude/skills/eval-opt/SKILL.md frontmatter (skill-scoped). Auto-declines MCP elicitation during overnight runs so unattended runs never pause; no-op interactively.
